naslov: Celtics and Bulls meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
tekst:
Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (3-1, fourth in the Eastern Conference)
              Boston; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EDT
              LINE: Celtics -11.5; over/under is 232.5
              BOTTOM LINE: The Boston Celtics take on the Chicago Bulls in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup.
              Boston finished 56-26 overall and 36-16 in Eastern Conference action last season. The Celtics gave up 107.2 points per game while committing 19.0 fouls last season.
              Chicago went 31-51 overall and 19-32 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Bulls averaged 7.6 steals, 5.0 blocks and 14.6 turnovers per game last season.
              The teams meet for the second time this season. The Celtics won 134-99 in the last matchup on Oct. 26.
              INJURIES: Celtics: Devin Carter: out (illness).
              Bulls: Tobe Awaka: day to day (ankle), Patrick Williams: day to day (groin), Nic Claxton: out (hamstring).
